description: This is a Java test class for PrefsXmlStorage, testing XML storage and retrieval of preference data structures in the context of the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: PrefsXmlStorageTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PrefsXmlStorage's XML serialization and deserialization of preference data.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates temporary file, and instantiates PrefsXmlStorage.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests by deleting temporary file.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Tests storing and loading a complex preference tree with nested items and values.

methods.name: testStoreOverwrites
methods.description: Verifies that storing preferences overwrites previous data correctly.

methods.name: testDoesNotStoreNull
methods.description: Ensures that null values are not stored and are handled appropriately during load.
